title: normDet of a block lower-triangular map between Euclidean products
statement:
Let E₁, E₂, F₁, F₂ be finite-dimensional real inner product spaces (in Type) with dim E₁ = dim F₁ and dim E₂ = dim F₂.
Give WithLp 2 (E₁ × E₂) and WithLp 2 (F₁ × F₂) their Euclidean (L²) product inner products, ⟨(u,v),(u',v')⟩ = ⟨u,u'⟩ + ⟨v,v'⟩. Their components are WithLp.fst and WithLp.snd.
Let G : WithLp 2 (E₁ × E₂) → WithLp 2 (F₁ × F₂), G₁₁ : E₁ → F₁ and G₂₂ : E₂ → F₂ be ℝ-linear maps such that:
(i) WithLp.fst(G(toLp(0, b))) = 0 for all b ∈ E₂;
(ii) G₁₁ a = WithLp.fst(G(toLp(a, 0))) for all a ∈ E₁;
(iii) G₂₂ b = WithLp.snd(G(toLp(0, b))) for all b ∈ E₂.
Then normDet(G) = normDet(G₁₁) · normDet(G₂₂), where normDet is Mathlib's LinearMap.normDet.
lean_statement: ∀ (E₁ E₂ F₁ F₂ : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E₁] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E₁] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E₁] [NormedAddCommGroup E₂] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E₂] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E₂] [NormedAddCommGroup F₁] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F₁] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F₁] [NormedAddCommGroup F₂] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F₂] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F₂] (G : WithLp 2 (E₁ × E₂) →ₗ[ℝ] WithLp 2 (F₁ × F₂)) (G₁₁ : E₁ →ₗ[ℝ] F₁) (G₂₂ : E₂ →ₗ[ℝ] F₂), Module.finrank ℝ E₁ = Module.finrank ℝ F₁ → Module.finrank ℝ E₂ = Module.finrank ℝ F₂ → (∀ b : E₂, WithLp.fst (G (WithLp.toLp 2 (0, b))) = 0) → (∀ a : E₁, G₁₁ a = WithLp.fst (G (WithLp.toLp 2 (a, 0)))) → (∀ b : E₂, G₂₂ b = WithLp.snd (G (WithLp.toLp 2 (0, b)))) → G.normDet = G₁₁.normDet * G₂₂.normDet
